# Plan for ISSUE-194

Scope developer and tester test execution through prompt guidance, with regression coverage for repository, embedded, and scaffolded copies.

**Shape: Routine.** The conflicting instructions are localized to four prompt files; existing harness tests provide the synchronization pattern.

## What we know

- Developer contract item 5 currently requires every trusted check; its PR revision paragraph also says to run required checks (`.swarm/prompts/developer.md:10`, `:24`). The embedded copy repeats both instructions (`internal/harness/templates/swarm/prompts/developer.md`).
- Tester contract item 2 currently requests approved validation commands, while item 3 already preserves provisional VALIDATION.md output and coordinator authority (`.swarm/prompts/tester.md:7-8`). The embedded tester copy matches.
- `TestDeveloperOutputInstructionsAndPromptSync` compares normalized repository/template bytes and checks scaffolded output (`internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go:11`). There is no equivalent tester sync coverage in this file.
- `TestShippedPRRevisionPrompts` expects the developer revision text to contain “required checks” (`internal/harness/scaffold_test.go:1099`); keep that phrase while assigning those checks to the coordinator.
- `TestDeveloperRequiredCheckInstructions` asserts the old all-checks phrase plus lint/format ownership (`internal/harness/scaffold_test.go:1230`). Update this test to the new contract, preserving lint/format coverage.
- `docs/developer.md:321` repeats the old agent policy; its changed-package explanation at lines 333–336 has no heading anchor yet.
- Import policy permits developer IMPLEMENTATION.md and tester VALIDATION.md separately (`internal/workflow/import_policy.go:25`). The coordinator calls validation.Validate and RecordTrustedValidation after the tester (`internal/workflow/engine.go:1080`). Existing import and trusted-validation tests cover these boundaries.
- `make check` runs formatting inspection, vet, staticcheck, and one race-enabled full suite (`Makefile`, targets lint, race, check).

## What we're assuming

No runtime change is needed: this WorkUnit changes agent instructions, not test selection machinery. Check this by reviewing the final diff: the implementation touchpoints are the four prompts, `internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go`, `internal/harness/scaffold_test.go` (`TestDeveloperRequiredCheckInstructions`), `docs/developer.md`, and the changelog fragment. Updating the existing required-check instruction test is assumed sufficient alongside the new sync test; confirm with the focused harness command before the package run.

## Open questions

No design questions block implementation. Whether the final `make check` passes is answered by the tester's single final run; environmental failures must be recorded rather than hidden by repeated suite runs.

## Implementation sequence and exact touchpoints

1. Update `.swarm/prompts/developer.md` and `internal/harness/templates/swarm/prompts/developer.md` identically. Replace the all-checks demand with: the coordinator reruns every required check; run TEST_PLAN.md commands and targeted changed-package tests first; run the full suite at most once, at the end, only if TEST_PLAN.md requires it. Avoid automatic reruns without changed code, a failure to investigate, or an unresolved concern. Align the task-snapshot and PR-revision paragraphs with this policy so they do not reintroduce blanket check execution. Keep “Fix lint and format findings yourself rather than leaving them for CI” and explicitly require fast format/lint/vet/staticcheck checks on changed files/packages (gofmt, go vet, go tool staticcheck). Remove repeated full test-suite runs, not this developer feedback loop. Preserve IMPLEMENTATION.md output ownership and other contract requirements.
2. Apply the same execution policy to `.swarm/prompts/tester.md` and `internal/harness/templates/swarm/prompts/tester.md`. Preserve reporting of failures/unverified criteria and provisional VALIDATION.md output; state explicitly that the tester verdict is advisory and the coordinator independently reruns every required check and writes the authoritative report. Preserve credential and claim-bound command restrictions.
3. In `internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go`, retain `TestDeveloperOutputInstructionsAndPromptSync` and add `TestWorkerTestScopeInstructionsAndPromptSync`, table-driven over developer/tester. Compare repository and embedded prompt bytes with CRLF normalization, initialize a temporary scaffold using InitRepository, and check scaffolded bytes match the template. Assert both roles retain all four execution requirements (coordinator checks, plan commands, changed-package tests first, conditional single final full suite). Assert tester advisory status and VALIDATION.md reporting. Update `TestDeveloperRequiredCheckInstructions` in `internal/harness/scaffold_test.go`: replace the obsolete all-checks assertion with coordinator ownership, TEST_PLAN.md, changed-package testing, and conditional single-final-suite assertions; retain lint/format ownership assertions and add explicit changed-file/package gofmt/vet/staticcheck coverage. These assertions must fail against the old prompts. Preserve existing output ownership assertions and existing import-policy/trusted-validation tests unchanged.
4. Reword `docs/developer.md:321` in plain developer prose: the coordinator reruns every required check, agents follow TEST_PLAN.md and changed-package tests, and developers run fast format/lint/vet/staticcheck checks and fix findings on changed code. State the conditional single final full-suite limit. Add a short heading immediately before the existing changed-package explanation at lines 333–336 (for example `##### Changed-package validation`) and link the rewritten paragraph to `#changed-package-validation`; preserve the explanation and its existing scope.
5. Add `changes/unreleased/194-scoped-agent-tests.md` with one human-readable bullet describing scoped developer/tester test runs and coordinator verification.
6. Follow TEST_PLAN.md. Developer records targeted results in IMPLEMENTATION.md; tester records verification and the single final make check result in VALIDATION.md. The coordinator independently executes its approved required checks.

No changes to validator policy, workflow authority, import logic, slash-command templates, or other harness instructions are planned. Extending the existing focused prompt test is preferable to adding runtime test-selection machinery, which is outside the objective.

<!-- swarm:guidance:start -->
## Operator guidance

> Planner: address all three required revisions (update TestDeveloperRequiredCheckInstructions to the new contract; reword docs/developer.md:321 and link to the changed-package section at 333-336; keep fast format/lint/vet/staticcheck checks on changed packages as a developer duty, removing only repeated full test-suite runs). Developer: notes in IMPLEMENTATION.md. Tester: results in VALIDATION.md. Run targeted tests; at most one full suite.

<!-- swarm:guidance:end -->

# Test plan for ISSUE-194

The coordinator reruns every approved required check. Agents run the focused commands below first. This plan requires exactly one final full-suite invocation, `make check`, assigned to the tester. Developer must not also run go test ./..., go test -race ./..., or make check. Do not repeat passing commands without a relevant change or unresolved concern. No tests are required during planning.

## Acceptance mapping

| Acceptance criterion | Verification |
| --- | --- |
| Developer/tester repository and template prompts explain coordinator checks, prioritize TEST_PLAN.md and changed-package tests, and permit at most one final full suite only when the plan requires it; copies stay synchronized | Add TestWorkerTestScopeInstructionsAndPromptSync in internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go. Exercise both roles, normalized repository/template equality, scaffold/template equality, and each execution-policy clause. Run the focused harness command below. Update TestDeveloperRequiredCheckInstructions to the new contract, retaining lint/format ownership and asserting changed-file/package gofmt/vet/staticcheck duties. Review developer snapshot/revision text for conflicting all-checks instructions. Check docs/developer.md:321 matches that policy and its new link resolves to the changed-package heading above the existing explanation. |
| Tester still writes VALIDATION.md and has an advisory verdict; existing import-policy and trusted-validation tests unchanged | New prompt test asserts tester reporting and advisory/coordinator authority text. Run unchanged workflow/import and lease/trusted-validation tests below. Review changed paths to confirm these tests and production authority code remain untouched. |
| make check passes | Tester runs make check once, last, after targeted checks and any fixes. Record its exit status and observed failures in VALIDATION.md. |

The required changelog fragment must exist at changes/unreleased/194-scoped-agent-tests.md with one `- ` bullet.

## Developer: targeted verification

After editing, format both changed Go test files and run fast checks on the changed package. Fix all format/lint/vet/staticcheck findings locally:

```bash
gofmt -s -w internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go internal/harness/scaffold_test.go
gofmt -s -l internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go internal/harness/scaffold_test.go
go vet ./internal/harness
go tool staticcheck ./internal/harness
go test ./internal/harness -run 'Test(WorkerTestScopeInstructionsAndPromptSync|DeveloperRequiredCheckInstructions|DeveloperOutputInstructionsAndPromptSync|DeveloperSnapshotInstructions|ShippedPRRevisionPrompts|DeveloperChangelogInstructions)$' -count=1
```

Demonstrate that the new regression assertions reject the old instruction text, using a temporary local restoration or equivalent isolated fixture, then restore the intended prompts. Never edit approved plan inputs. Run the changed package once after the final edits:

```bash
go test ./internal/harness
```

Verify the rewritten developer-guide paragraph accurately describes coordinator checks, planned/changed-package tests, the full-suite limit, and developer lint/format duties. Confirm its relative `#changed-package-validation` link matches the added heading; check any changed shell snippets with `bash -n`. Review the final changed-path list against PLAN.md, including the two harness test files and docs/developer.md.

Record commands, outcomes, and any blockers in `.swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md`. Keep `.swarm/active/VALIDATION.md` for the tester.

## Tester: boundary verification, then one final check

Review IMPLEMENTATION.md and the final changed files. Reuse successful unchanged-package evidence; rerun the focused harness command only if developer evidence is missing, files changed afterward, or a specific concern needs verification. Run these existing boundary tests without modifying them:

```bash
go test ./internal/workflow -run 'Test(WritableImportPolicy|WritableImportPolicyUsesTrustedPatterns|TesterReadsApprovedInputs)$' -count=1
go test ./internal/lease -run 'Test(TrustedValidationCannotBeImported|GatewayValidationCannotGainReuseAuthority)$' -count=1
```

Finally, run the sole agent full-suite command:

```bash
make check
```

This includes go vet ./..., go tool staticcheck ./..., formatting inspection, and go test -race ./.... Do not add another full-suite run. If it fails, report the failure and use targeted commands to diagnose/verify fixes; the coordinator will rerun every required check. Record actual results, unresolved failures, and any unverified acceptance criteria in `.swarm/active/VALIDATION.md`; the tester report remains advisory. Do not invoke claim-bound validation or request coordinator credentials.

<!-- swarm:guidance:start -->
## Operator guidance

> Planner: address all three required revisions (update TestDeveloperRequiredCheckInstructions to the new contract; reword docs/developer.md:321 and link to the changed-package section at 333-336; keep fast format/lint/vet/staticcheck checks on changed packages as a developer duty, removing only repeated full test-suite runs). Developer: notes in IMPLEMENTATION.md. Tester: results in VALIDATION.md. Run targeted tests; at most one full suite.

<!-- swarm:guidance:end -->

VERDICT: APPROVED

# Review of ISSUE-194 plan

The revised PLAN.md and TEST_PLAN.md address all three operator-required revisions. The plan stays within the WorkUnit scope, and every cited fact matched the workspace.

## Audit

| Item | Status | Evidence / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Objective: developer and tester prompts (repo and template copies) direct agents to TEST_PLAN.md commands and changed-package tests, with at most one full suite at the end and only when the plan requires it | Covered | PLAN steps 1–2 cover all four files. The repo and template copies are identical today (`diff` shows no differences). Step 1 also aligns the task-snapshot paragraph (`.swarm/prompts/developer.md:20`, "Run the approved build and test commands") and the PR-revision paragraph (`:24`), so the old blanket instruction can't come back through them. |
| Out of scope: validator required checks and verdict authority | Respected | No changes to `required-checks.yaml`, `import_policy.go`, or `engine.go`. PLAN states this explicitly. |
| Constraint: allow_harness_changes | Satisfied | WorkUnit sets `Allow Harness Changes: true`. `.swarm/prompts/**` is the only protected path touched. |
| Constraint: changelog fragment | Covered | PLAN step 5 adds `changes/unreleased/194-scoped-agent-tests.md`, and TEST_PLAN checks it has a single `- ` bullet. |
| AC1: prompts say the coordinator runs every check, plan and changed-package tests come first, and the full suite runs at most once; a test keeps the copies in sync | Covered | New table-driven `TestWorkerTestScopeInstructionsAndPromptSync` checks repo, template, and scaffold copies for both roles, following the existing `TestDeveloperOutputInstructionsAndPromptSync` pattern (`internal/harness/developer_prompt_test.go:11`). The tester role previously had no sync test, so this closes a real gap. |
| AC2: tester still writes VALIDATION.md, its verdict stays advisory, and existing import-policy and trusted-validation tests are unchanged | Covered | The cited tests exist: `internal/workflow/import_policy_test.go:18,128,214` and `internal/lease/validation_reuse_test.go:11,50`. The tester runs them without modifying them. The new prompt test asserts the advisory wording and VALIDATION.md. |
| AC3: make check passes | Covered | The tester runs it once, as the last step. `Makefile:44` defines `check: lint race`. |
| Revision 1: update `TestDeveloperRequiredCheckInstructions` | Addressed | Its current assertion, `"run every command in the trusted required checks"` (`internal/harness/scaffold_test.go:1239`), will break once the prompt changes. The plan replaces it with the new contract and keeps the lint/format assertions. `TestShippedPRRevisionPrompts` (`:1099`) keeps its `"required checks"` term because the plan preserves that phrase. |
| Revision 2: reword `docs/developer.md:321` and link it to 333–336 | Addressed | Line 321 still contains the old "Run every required check" wording. Line 333 starts the changed-package explanation and has no heading. The plan adds `##### Changed-package validation`, which matches the existing heading level at `:364`, and links to `#changed-package-validation`. |
| Revision 3: developers keep fast fmt/vet/staticcheck checks on changed packages | Addressed | PLAN step 1 keeps "Fix lint and format findings yourself" and adds gofmt, go vet, and staticcheck on changed files and packages. TEST_PLAN's developer section runs those commands on `./internal/harness`. |
| Shape fit (Routine) | OK | The edits are prompt and doc text plus focused tests, with no extra ceremony. The single assumption (no runtime change needed) is labeled and gets checked by reviewing the diff. |
| Run budget (operator: at most one full suite) | OK | Only the tester runs a full suite (`make check`). The developer is explicitly forbidden from running `go test ./...`, `-race ./...`, or `make check`. The developer runs the changed package once with `go test ./internal/harness`. |
| Sandbox reachability | OK | Every command runs locally. Nothing depends on GitHub or claim-bound validation. |

## Non-blocking notes for the developer

1. When showing that the new assertions reject the old prompt text, restore the prompts afterwards and confirm that `diff` between the repo and template copies is clean. Record that check in IMPLEMENTATION.md.
2. Keep the new docs paragraph free of agent-prompt wording, and keep its existing sentence about the build cache. It should read as developer guidance, per the docs invariant in goals.
3. In the tester prompt, make the conditional clear: running `make check` is permitted because TEST_PLAN.md requires it. The prompt should not suggest the tester always runs a full suite.

## Follow-ups (not required here)

- None required. If the scoped-run guidance works, a later WorkUnit could make the same change to the slash-command templates (`.claude/commands/**`, `.opencode/commands/**`), which this plan deliberately leaves out.

## Operator guidance

> Planner: address all three required revisions (update TestDeveloperRequiredCheckInstructions to the new contract; reword docs/developer.md:321 and link to the changed-package section at 333-336; keep fast format/lint/vet/staticcheck checks on changed packages as a developer duty, removing only repeated full test-suite runs). Developer: notes in IMPLEMENTATION.md. Tester: results in VALIDATION.md. Run targeted tests; at most one full suite.

<!-- swarm:guidance:end -->
